resource_controls.limitations: Existing wrapper rejects next statement after test-adjusted cap; includes three setup statements. Not a byte or CPU cap.
64 catalog rows returned despite a declared 2-row probe threshold. The existing wrapper has no row-budget argument/counter; this does not claim a 25,000-row production threshold was tested.
Existing writer rejects 17 bytes against patched 16-byte cap before emitting. This tests writer payloads, not whole-process temporary storage.
Zero-deadline execution aborts, but handler is removed before fetch. Four rows fetched after a 20ms deadline. Blocking calls and fetch are not covered.
Exploratory parent terminates one sleeping worker at 0.309s for a 0.3s wait. Not a strict total audit bound and not implemented in existing audit runner.
Direct child terminated and joined in this experiment. Parent scheduling and termination latency remain; not a hard real-time guarantee.
Descendant survived parent termination; self-expired after 3s. Self-expiry is not enforced tree cleanup.
Windows working set measurable; 1MiB allocation crosses declared 512KiB incremental probe with no refusal. No hard quota configured or demonstrated.
8KiB generated scratch observed after writing across declared 4KiB probe. No process-wide quota or SQLite spill limit demonstrated.
OS process ReadTransferCount includes unrelated I/O and is cumulative, not per-target or physical disk bytes. No hard logical database-read cap or physical I/O attribution provided.

engineering_decisions.recommended_contract: Require demonstrated quiescence/no sidecars, fail closed; no checkpoint or repair.
engineering_decisions.residual_risk: Checks detect changes, do not exclude writers or close validation/open races.

engineering_decisions.recommended_contract: Retain hard byte-budget blocker; define logical read metric and evaluate enforcement without substituting rows/pages/statements.
